name: atdd
description: Gherkin-first ATDD pipeline. /atdd:gherkin turns a spec from your issue tracker into reviewed Gherkin scenarios; /atdd:build implements them and loops reviewer → QA → quality gate until clean; /atdd:cover binds them to behavior the code already has as acceptance tests, changing nothing but tests; /atdd:cover-queue does that one .feature file at a time, unattended, on stacked branches with a PR per file.
